purpose.summary: This is a CICS online banking detail-screen program (client side of a split DFH0CALL demo). It handles account inquiry, add (open), and update (change) operations by sending/receiving a BMS detail map, linking to a CRUD server program (BKPXXS1) for file I/O, and returning control to the menu transaction.

notable_features: EXEC CICS (HANDLE CONDITION, LINK, SEND MAP, RECEIVE MAP, RETURN)
BMS map handling with DFHBMSCA attribute bytes (DFHBMUNN, DFHBMPRO)
Multiple COPY statements (BKMXXGA, BKMXXGB, BKCLOG, DFHBMSCA, BKCLINK, BKCACCT)
Currency symbol comments for £ and ¥ variants
High GOTO count (22) typical of older CICS pseudo-conversational style
verdict.notes: File is truncated at 16000 chars out of 31674 bytes; the CHECK paragraph and subsequent validation/file-write logic are cut off. The program is clearly a production-style IBM CICS COBOL program from a banking demo suite (DFH0CALL split into client BKPXXC2 and server BKPXXS1). Comment ratio is high (44.8%) due to extensive inline documentation. All 391 lines are exactly 80 characters (fixed format with sequence numbers).
